body:
MYK'S OBSERVATION (2026-07-26): the live status artifact is a great opportunity to dogfood Loam apps. It is — the board is exactly Loam's shape: a stream of small claims (a PR opened, a lane reported, a ticket moved) that many writers append and one lens renders, where history matters and the current view is just latest-wins over the ground.

THE SHAPE: a long-lived board STORE (Myk's own operator seed, a home he chooses — never an agent-created ~/.loam, per the standing rule), with: a `BoardItem` schema + claim templates (kind: waiting|lane|ticket, title, seam, url, status, estMinutes), so one board event is ONE delta through the GraphQL door; a RENDERER at a route serving the board itself — the postcard pattern from the operator review, grown up; a public declaration so the LAN reads it tokenless. Sessions (Fable and lanes) write via the authed door with a granted author each — which makes the board's own history an attributed record of who reported what, when: the board becomes its own journal.

WHAT IT DOGFOODS, deliberately: (1) a long-lived store under real daily writes — every driver bug T67/T66 class finds a permanent home to bite; (2) multi-writer grants and revocation on real operations; (3) renderers as the app surface — if the board page is not pleasant to build, §23 is not done; (4) AS-OF as a product feature: "show me the board as of yesterday morning" is the demo that sells §26 in one sentence; (5) the operational gaps the operator review already found become daily pain until fixed — T103's --host (the phone needs it), T104's front door, and T102's pen the moment the board grows an approve-note form. A permanent internal app is a standing operator review.

THE ARTIFACT STAYS, as the mirror: the claude.ai board remains the phone-reachable snapshot, but GENERATED — a small script queries the board store's view and emits the HTML the session republishes, so the store is the single source of truth and the artifact is a render of it. (True live in-page reads over the LAN come later, or via T79's artifact target once the connector story matures — that convergence is deliberate: this board is ALSO the natural first customer for the §30 artifact host.)

RELATIONS, not edges: T92 (the container console) — this board is its seed and its first screen; T103/T102/T104 — this app is their motivating customer; T79's artifact target — the board is candidate #1. DESIGN-STAGE FIRST: a short working spec (the schema, the claim templates, the write flow from sessions, the render) that Myk signs off — his store, his seed, his board.
title: The board becomes a Loam app — dogfood the whole stack on our own operations
